chapter: Violin, the 1936 tour and the photo
title: The picture, the program and who booked the tour
summary: Allen asks for names in the band photograph and who booked the tour; Dog Bank of Florence, Alabama, booked them unseen.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: And the secretary will call me to the phone, you know? Mm-hmm. I wanted to get the name of the people in that picture, too.
Oh, yeah. You got the picture here or the program? No, the picture, I'll get it... I left it over there. I got a program. Uh, let me go get it. I got it in my little shop bag there.
All right, fine. Who booked you on the tour?
Dog Bank from Florence, Alabama. And we have...we didn't know the man, never met him until we got in Alabama. He had a job there and we met him there.
